description: This file defines the ClaimService class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, responsible for handling claim-related business logic, especially generating reference IDs using data access objects and date/time helpers.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: Service class providing claim-related operations, including generating unique reference IDs for claims.

methods.name: getClaimDao
methods.description: Returns the ClaimDao instance, creating a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique reference ID for claims based on current date and next claim ID.
